source: This is why ZXNAME0000XZ/ZXNAME0001XZ are best understood as inference-oriented architectural changes. They can also change training parameter counts and projection work, but their signature benefit is that fewer distinct K/V vectors are produced and cached.
zh: 这就是为什么 ZXNAME0000XZ/ZXNAME0001XZ 最好被理解为面向推理的架构变化。它们还可以更改训练参数计数和投影工作，但其标志性好处是生成和缓存的不同 K/V 向量更少。
